text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road couldn't secure a spot in 
the "Japan Cup". And the next day, she 
didn't show up to class...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Please let me take a break from 
training." "I want to go talk to her." 
Admire Vega clearly stated her intentions 
and headed to her rival's side.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After engaging in an unaccustomed bout of 
"slacking off" together, at Admire Vega's 
invitation, the two looked up at the 
starry sky from a hill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Narita Top Road confessed, "Maybe this 
is as far as I go..." Admire Vega 
responded—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"It's precisely because you're like this 
that I want to run with you," she says, 
reaching out with the very hand she once 
brushed away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Let's race together again." Holding hands 
beneath the starry sky, the two made their 
promise.
